evidence_snippets: REST Resource: customer.devices.chromeos Methods batchChangeStatus POST /admin/directory/v1/customer/{customerId}/devices/chromeos:batchChangeStatus Changes the status of a batch of ChromeOS devices. countChromeOsDevices GET /admin/directory/v1/customer/{customerId}/devices/chromeos:countChromeOsDevices Counts ChromeOS devices matching the request. issueCommand POST /admin/directory/v1/customer/{customerId}/devices/chromeos/{deviceId}:issueCommand Issues a command for the device to execute.

REST Resource: customer.devices.chromeos.commands Methods get GET /admin/directory/v1/customer/{customerId}/devices/chromeos/{deviceId}/commands/{commandId} Gets command data a specific command issued to the device.
